name: Texas Eastern Line 31 Expansion Project (Line 31 Loop and Line 14-P Lateral)
monitor_reason: no data center tie: no validated ref that names this pipeline mentions data centers. The Mississippi Free Press and the state air permit response name the power plant but not the pipeline, and the adjacency to an Amazon campus comes from commenters. Also about 19 km (11.8 mi), under the 25 km floor.
researcher_notes: This is a real Texas Eastern project with no row of its own, and it is not an existing row under another name. The Federal Register scoping notice from March 2026 and the Enbridge project page describe a 10.2 mile 36-inch loop and a 1.6 mile 16-inch lateral to Entergy Mississippi's planned Traceview power plant in Madison County, with 125,000 Dth/d. The Enbridge page now shows a larger scope (up to 160,000 Dth/d, about 11.5 miles of loop, October 2028 in service), so check values against FERC docket CP26-75 before staging. The Enbridge page, the scoping notice and the Gas Compression Magazine article do not mention data centers. The Mississippi Free Press article ties the Amazon deal to the plant, but it does not name the pipeline, and the nearness to the Amazon campus comes from commenters. DataCenter stays blank. Revisit if the FERC filing, Enbridge or Entergy ties this project to data center demand.
